An overview of PomPom\'s policies and frequently asked questions. Tap each section to see details.

PomPom is a cosmetics app that brings a personalized shopping and beauty experience. We combine product recommendations, a sharing community and AI tools to help you find the products that suit you best.

We are committed to protecting your personal information. Your data is used only to provide and improve our services, and is never shared with third parties without your consent. You may request to view or delete your data at any time.

You may request an exchange or return within 7 days of receiving your order if the product is unused with its seal intact. Refunds are processed within 3–5 business days after PomPom receives the returned item.
Orders are delivered within 2–5 business days depending on your area. Free shipping for orders from 500,000₫. You can track your order progress in "My Orders".

• How do I track my order? Go to Profile → My Orders and select the order status.\n• What if I forgot my password? Use the change-password feature in Settings, or contact support.\n• My voucher doesn\'t work? Check the voucher\'s conditions and expiry date in the Voucher section.
Need more help? Reach us at:\n• Email: support@pompom.vn\n• Hotline: 1900 1234 (8:00–22:00 daily)
